patch_description: When a parent has stalled, generate a short path toward a distant, high-quality archive member. Each path step inserts a target link using a degree-preserving two-switch, while avoiding removal of links already shared with the target. Screen a few valid intermediate networks and reserve part of the LP batch for them. This provides a directed escape from a local basin without replacing the existing bottleneck-focused neighborhood search or spending LP calls on every path step.
